permissions.send: Write and receive Slow Mail letters

settings.km_per_day_help: How far a letter travels in a day, when both members are on Member Map. 2,000 means Paris to New York in about three days.
settings.min_hours_help: Even next-door neighbors wait at least this long.
settings.max_hours_help: Even the far side of the world is no farther than this. 168 hours is a week.
settings.default_hours_help: Used when Member Map isn't installed, or when either member isn't on the map for the other. Each pair of members gets a little more or less, so it doesn't stand out.
settings.daily_limit: Letters a member can send a day
settings.new_pals_daily: New people a member can write to a day
settings.new_pals_daily_help: Letters to someone they have never written to, and never had a letter from. This is what keeps spam out.
settings.privacy_help: Letters are encrypted before they are saved, and nobody can read them but the two members, admins included, unless the recipient reports one, which shows that one letter to moderators. A letter on its way doesn't show up anywhere for its recipient until it arrives. Travel times use only the place each member chose on Member Map (a city, a region or a country), and only when the other member can see them there. They are rounded and jittered, so nobody can work out a location from them.
settings.backup_help: Letters are encrypted with a key kept in storage/slow-mail/key, never in the database. Back that folder up along with your database. Without the key, letters can't be read.

page.title: Slow Mail
page.intro: Write a letter to another member. It takes its time to arrive, the farther apart you live, the longer the journey, and then it's theirs to open.
page.guest: Log in to write and read letters.

inbox.empty_hint: Letters take a while to arrive. Why not write one?

outbox.empty: You haven't sent any letters yet.
outbox.empty_hint: Pick a member, choose a stamp, and send them a few words. They'll get it in a day or two.

letter.unreadable: This letter can't be read on this forum any more. Its key is missing.
letter.block_confirm: Stop letters between you and {name}? Neither of you will be able to write to the other, and letters on their way will be returned. You can change this from your pen pals.

report.title: Report this letter
report.explain: The words of this letter will be shown to the forum's moderators, so they can act on it. Nothing else you've written or received is shared, and {name} isn't told who reported it.
report.block: Also stop letters between me and {name}
report.done: Thank you. The moderators will take a look.

reports.intro: Letters their recipients chose to show you. Only these letters, and only to moderators.

write.title: Write a letter
write.takes: This letter will take about {time} to reach {name}, arriving around
write.no_map: The journey takes the forum's usual time.
write.sent: Your letter is on its way to {name}. It should get there in {time}.

pals.none: No pen pals yet. Once a letter arrives between you and another member, they show up here.
pals.meta: {count, plural, one {# letter} other {# letters}} · last {date}

seek.title: Looking for a pen pal
seek.intro: List yourself, and we'll suggest members who are listed too, best match first. You'll only see others once you're listed yourself.
seek.where: Where would you like them to live?
seek.needs_map: This uses your place on the member map. Without one, you'll match only members who don't mind where you are.
seek.listed: You're listed, looking for a pen pal ({region}).
seek.no_matches: Nobody to suggest just yet. Check back soon.

settings.accept_pals: Only members who have had a letter from me
settings.accept_help: Slow Mail letters. Letters already on their way still arrive.

errors.slow_mail_wait_for_delivery: You have 3 letters on their way to this member. Wait for one to arrive.
